necessity_paragraph: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and a history of atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery (I25.10) alongside nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency (I34.0). To evaluate the correlation between these symptoms and potential arrhythmias, a cardiac event monitoring study (CPT 93271) is ordered for further diagnostic assessment. This service addresses the specific clinical need to correlate symptoms with arrhythmias, distinct from the bundled procedure cited in denial code CO-97.
